beats.spoken: This is a quick parent briefing.

beats.spoken: Not a film for your child to watch!

beats.spoken: You learn the method here.

beats.spoken: Then you work from the written page, beside your child.

beats.spoken: If anything clashes with how your school teaches…
beats.line: If anything clashes with how your school teaches…

beats.spoken: Follow the school…
beats.line: Follow the school.

beats.spoken: Here’s the idea.
beats.line: Here’s the idea.

beats.spoken: A number fact is a small truth.
beats.line: A number fact is a small truth.

beats.spoken: Such as: 6 and 4 make 10.
beats.line: Such as: 6 and 4 make 10.

beats.spoken: Or: 7 take away 2 equals 5.
beats.line: Or: 7 take away 2 equals 5.

beats.spoken: Fluency does not mean shouting answers against a timer.
beats.line: Fluency does not mean shouting answers against a timer.

beats.spoken: It means the child does not have to start at 1 and climb every time.
beats.line: It means the child does not have to start at 1 and climb every time.

beats.spoken: And here’s how school typically teaches it.
beats.line: And here’s how school typically teaches it.

visual.caption: A ten-frame: two rows of five, still empty.

beats.spoken: Most schools use a ten-frame.
beats.line: Most schools use a ten-frame.

visual.caption: Two rows of five. The frame is the picture, not the sum.

beats.spoken: Two rows of five.
beats.line: Two rows of five.

beats.spoken: They pair that with a part–whole picture: one whole number made of two parts.
beats.line: They pair that with a part–whole picture: one whole number made of two parts.

visual.caption: A family of facts: 6 and 4, then 4 and 6.

beats.spoken: They will teach families of facts together.
beats.line: They will teach families of facts together.

visual.caption: A number bond: two parts that make a whole.

beats.spoken: Such as: 6 plus 4.
beats.line: Such as: 6 plus 4.

beats.spoken: Or: 4 plus 6.
beats.line: Or: 4 plus 6.

beats.spoken: Or: 10 take away 4.
beats.line: Or: 10 take away 4.

beats.spoken: Or: 10 take away 6.
beats.line: Or: 10 take away 6.

beats.spoken: School often calls that pair a number bond: two parts that make a whole.
beats.line: School often calls that pair a number bond: two parts that make a whole.

visual.caption: A number bond: two parts that make a whole.

scenes.heading: They can do 3 + 2 with objects but go blank when they see 3 + 2 written.

beats.spoken: Here’s one mix-up to watch for.
beats.line: Here’s one mix-up to watch for.

beats.spoken: They can do 3 plus 2 with objects but go blank when they see 3 plus 2 written.
beats.line: They can do 3 plus 2 with objects but go blank when they see 3 plus 2 written.

beats.spoken: Build it with objects, say it in words, then show the symbols written underneath.
beats.line: Build it with objects, say it in words, then show the symbols written underneath.

beats.spoken: Don’t use words and symbols as the starting point.
beats.line: Don’t use words and symbols as the starting point.

beats.spoken: Tonight’s activity.
beats.line: Tonight’s activity.

beats.spoken: This is the task outline — look at the written instructions for the full task.
beats.line: This is the task outline — look at the written instructions for the full task.

beats.spoken: Make 10 in two colours.
beats.line: Make 10 in two colours

visual.caption: Fill 6 of one type. The empty spaces are the other part.

beats.spoken: Fill 6 spaces on the frame with one colour or type of object.
beats.line: Fill 6 spaces on the frame with one colour or type of object.

beats.spoken: Ask how many empty spaces, then fill them with the other type.
beats.line: Ask how many empty spaces, then fill them with the other type.

beats.spoken: Fifteen minutes, or three number bonds, is plenty…
beats.line: Fifteen minutes, or three number bonds, is plenty.

beats.spoken: Whichever comes first…
beats.line: Whichever comes first.

beats.spoken: Here’s what you’re aiming for.
beats.line: Here’s what you’re aiming for.

beats.spoken: You can show 7 on a ten-frame and see, without counting from 1, that 3 empty spaces make 10.
beats.line: You can show 7 on a ten-frame and see, without counting from 1, that 3 empty spaces make 10.

beats.spoken: One check from the page…
beats.line: One check from the page.

beats.spoken: Show 8 on the frame.
beats.line: Show 8 on the frame.

beats.spoken: How many more to make 10?
beats.line: How many more to make 10?

beats.spoken: Here’s what you want to see.
beats.line: Here’s what you want to see.

beats.spoken: They can say there are 2 empty spaces, or count each empty cell once.
beats.line: They can say there are 2 empty spaces, or count each empty cell once.
